For stores on self-serve plans, orders processed using offline payment methods and payment providers that are not on our Embedded Payment Provider list are assessed an Open Payment Provider fee. Orders processed through Embedded Payment Providers and Performance plan stores operating under contracted terms are not subject to this fee.

Orders processed externally to the BigCommerce platform are also subject to the fee. This includes orders placed using offline payment methods, orders originating from marketplaces like eBay or Etsy, orders processed through a point-of-sale (POS) app, and orders created via the API.

identifier: Refund customer through third party provider
statement: The Refund customer through third party provider option allows you to record refunds which are not processed through the original payment provider. This allows you to record refunds that are processed via methods that are not native to BigCommerce, such as gift certificates, bank transfers, by check, and physically in-store.

The Manual payment option can be used in record-keeping for over-the-phone or in-person orders that have already been paid. Note that these orders are counted toward your BigCommerce account billing.

identifier: Finalize Manual Orders using Manual Payments
statement: To select the Manual payment option during the Payment step, the Finalize Manual Orders using Manual Payments permission must be enabled.

Be careful! Payment methods cannot be changed once an order is created. If you need to change the payment method after processing a manual order, cancel or refund the order and then create a new order.

Cash payment — When a shopper uses a cash payment method to place an order, they receive a payment slip or voucher to present to a participating retail location. From there, the shopper completes the transaction in cash and the merchant is notified of the successful payment. Examples of cash payment APMs include Boleto Bancário and Fawry.
